author: Ari Koslow
title: Dustin May (back) to start Thursday
desc: Dustin May is back on the mound on Thursday against the Braves.
impact: May had his last start skipped because of lingering back pain. He makes his return on Thursday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Miles Mikolas suspended five games
desc: The MLB has suspended Miles Mikolas five games.
impact: Mikolas gets handed a suspension for his involvement in this week's incident between Willson Contreras and Cade Cavalli. It is unclear if he will appeal the suspension.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cade Cavalli given seven-game suspension
desc: The MLB has suspended Cade Cavalli seven games.
impact: Cavalli and Willson Contreras each got seven-game suspensions following an incident earlier this week. It is unclear if either of them will appeal their suspensions.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nate Eaton suspended three games
desc: The MLB has suspended Nate Eaton three games.
impact: Eaton gets suspended following his involvement in the incident between Willson Contreras and Cade Cavalli. It is unclear if he will appeal the suspension.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Willson Contreras handed seven-game suspension
desc: The MLB has suspended Willson Contreras seven games.
impact: Contreras and Cade Cavalli each got seven-game suspensions following an incident earlier this week. It is unclear if either of them will appeal their suspensions.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Eric Cerantola designated for assignment
desc: The Royals designated Eric Cerantola for assignment.
impact: Cerantola loses his spot on the 40-man roster for Kansas City. He will head to waivers as a result.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Salvador Perez dealing with elbow soreness
desc: Salvador Perez is dealing with a sore left elbow.
impact: Perez is not in the lineup on Thursday. The Royals selected the contract of Luke Maile as insurance.

author: Ari Koslow
title: John Rave optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Royals optioned John Rave to Triple-A Omaha.
impact: Rave went 4-for-18 since being called up in mid-June. Luke Maile is up as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luke Maile has contract selected by Royals
desc: The Royals selected the contract of Luke Maile.
impact: Maile will add depth behind the plate with Salvador Perez dealing with a sore left elbow.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cole Ragans (elbow) undergoes surgery, to miss 10-12 months
desc: Royals manager Matt Quatraro told reporters Cole Ragans underwent a UCL repair in his left-elbow and is expected to be sidelined around 10-12 months.
impact: Ragans will begin his rehab process. He will be sidelined into next season. He posted a 4.84 ERA across eight starts this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jarred Kelenic elects free agency
desc: Jarred Kelenic has elected free agency.
impact: Kelenic declined an outright assignment to Triple-A Round Rock. He will look to land another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chris Paddack elects free agency
desc: Chris Paddack has elected free agency.
impact: Paddack declined an outright assignment to Triple-A Round Rock. He will look to land another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Joe Ross elects free agency
desc: Joe Ross has elected free agency.
impact: Ross declined an outright assignment to Triple-A Round Rock. He will look to land another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jordan Montgomery (elbow) transfers rehab assignment to Triple-A
desc: The Rangers transferred Jordan Montgomery's rehab assignment to Triple-A Round Rock.
impact: Montgomery had been with Double-A Frisco. He should be activated at some point later in July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Winston Santos optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Rangers optioned Winston Santos to Triple-A Round Rock.
impact: Santos returns to Triple-A to make room for Ben Peoples.
